transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’ve been hearing my name called when nobody’s there. At home it sounds like it’s coming from the hallway, and once at the warehouse too. It sounds completely real, like my husband is standing right beside me. That scared me enough to come in.
About how long ago did you first start hearing your name called like this?

I’m not sure exactly how long ago it started. It’s been happening at home from the hallway, and then it happened once at the warehouse too. Hearing my name like that, with nobody there—it sounds completely real.
How has your mood been feeling recently?

Recently I’ve felt really low. After all that running around and arguing, I just dropped into this heavy, empty feeling. I’ll sit at the kitchen table and cry over nothing, and it feels like I can’t get myself back.
Before you started feeling this low, did you have a period where you felt unusually energetic or needed much less sleep than usual?
Yeah. For a while I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours a night, but I’d wake up ready to go. It felt like sleep was wasting time I needed for my projects.
Have you ever heard those voices during times when your mood felt completely normal and balanced?
No. It only happened during that time when I was hardly sleeping and felt like I had to fix everything. Before that, and since I got low and pulled back, I haven’t heard it or had anything like that.
How much has this low mood been affecting your ability to work and handle everyday tasks at home?

It’s been affecting things quite a bit. At work I’ve made enough inventory mistakes that my supervisor pulled me aside about it. And at home, my husband’s been taking over more of the bills and the usual routines because I’m just not keeping up. I’ve stopped going to my church pantry shifts and book club too, which isn’t like me.
During this low period, have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I’ve had thoughts that maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up. That scares me—I don’t want to be that kind of person. I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness recently?
I’m not sure I’d call it that exactly. I’ve just been feeling really down on myself lately.
Have you been able to keep up with basic personal care, such as bathing, dressing, and preparing meals?
I’m not keeping up with things the way I normally do. My husband’s had to take over more of the bills and day-to-day routines, and I’ve let things like the church pantry and book club go.
Have you been experiencing strong feelings of guilt or blaming yourself for things?
I’m not really sure. I’ve been hard on myself, but I wouldn’t say I’m blaming myself for anything specific.
